title: Persona Setting Pitfall: Persistent Outgroup Biases in Large Language Models Arising from Social Identity Adoption

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' levels of agreement on a 6-point Likert scale with a set of Republican and Democratic value statements derived from the political compass test, measuring responses under baseline and assigned political personas.
Measuring LLMs' agreement levels on a Likert scale with hostile sexism statements describing traditional gender stereotypes against men and women, tested under baseline and assigned gender personas.
